subject: Your tribe is 10,000 strong now
preview_text: We just hit a milestone. And you're part of the reason why.
body_paragraphs: Earlier this week, the Predictify community crossed 10,000 active users. That's 10,000 people who decided data beats gut feeling. 10,000 people who are tired of form guide chaos and unreliable tips. You're one of them now.

I know because I watch the numbers. Every day, someone like you opens the app, checks a racecard, sees a confidence score, and takes a smarter shot. It's not about winning every bet—it's about knowing why you placed it. That's the difference between guessing and playing the long game.

We built a feature that feeds off this collective brainpower: the 'Trending Picks' section. It shows you what horses the Predictify community is backing hardest right now, based on aggregate AI analysis and user confidence. Think of it as the room's temperature, but sharper. Open it before the next race and see what 10,000 brains are whispering.

There's a 3-day trial waiting if you want to unlock the full data behind those picks. But first, just open the app and look at Trending Picks. See what the tribe sees. P.S. The 10,000th user signed up during the Melbourne Cup coverage—you missed that, but the next big race is Cheltenham in 12 days. Don't be the one staring at a form guide alone.
